description: Make the phase-start rule of the measure-guard closeout guard a note in place of a deny, so a task can start or close while an earlier phase has no checkpoint (PM request, 2026-11-09).
deviation_notes: The spec review (round 1 pass, 3 Major) changed the design from a removal of the rule to a note in place of the deny. The OpenCode bun test keeps the old V18 failure (tech-debt row of 2026-11-09). The Review A reviewer read the logs because its shell permission denied the test commands.
